records.title: process_job recover branch lacks status whitelist
records.disposition_rationale: Peer actions already whitelist statuses; recover omission is a dispatcher code gap, not a docs misread.
records.divergence_description: Recover executes without an explicit status conjunct required by REQ-002.
records.code_behavior: app/storage.py:2223-2224 bare recover branch calls process_recover.
records.proposed_fix: Add status conjunct matching selection set.

records.title: Reversible cloud hide skips concurrent VersionId detection
records.disposition_rationale: Scheduled provider_version_id is loaded but unused for compare; S3 delete-marker mechanics do not preclude Head/compare.
records.divergence_description: Unversioned delete hides current without detecting scheduled≠current.
records.documented_intent: Abort or audit when current generation ≠ scheduled Archive Version.
records.code_behavior: app/storage.py:2099-2102 delete_object without Head compare; rename 1622-1625 same class.
records.proposed_fix: Head current VersionId and abort on mismatch before marker.

records.title: List-only backup verification promoted to verified success
records.disposition_rationale: Producer returns ok True for TOC-only and consumer marks verified; contradicts restore-verification fitness.
records.divergence_description: pg_restore_list mode is treated as full verified success.
records.documented_intent: List-only must not equal isolated restore success for consumers.
records.code_behavior: metadata_backups.py:447-456 ok True; storage.py:2578-2600 status verified on ok.
records.proposed_fix: Return ok False for list-only and/or require temp_database mode in consumer.

records.title: csrf_token_for ignores session_version force-logout
records.disposition_rationale: resolve_session already enforces session_version; CSRF layer omission is a concrete code parity gap.
records.divergence_description: Force-logout does not invalidate CSRF token lookup.
records.documented_intent: CSRF lookup returns None when session_version diverges.
records.proposed_fix: Join users and compare session_version in csrf_token_for.

records.title: README Users overclaims operator free-space
records.disposition_rationale: Code/tests correctly enforce owner-only; README Users wording is the compensation failure.
records.divergence_description: Users section advertises operator free-space contrary to authoritative code.
records.documented_intent: Only primary owner may free local space.
records.proposed_fix: Edit README Users bullet to exclude free-space from operator capabilities.
